claim: A nonzero nonnegative real-analytic determinant on a connected interval has an analytic square root unique up to global sign.
consequence: Once a source-derived Xi-squared determinant exists, orientation requires only base-point normalization; the hard step is the noncircular source construction.
hostile_control: The skew block [[0,f],[-f,0]] has Pfaffian f for every analytic f, so a Pfaffian containing Xi in its entries is tautological.
open_target: Construct cutoff-compatible source-defined skew lifts of the paired archimedean-prime transfer determinant without Xi values or zeros.
status: algebraic gate; no Xi operator construction or RH proof
